description: A signed package index and package manifests for distributing code and skills. A package is data; installing it is a separate, explicit action and no manifest can grant authority or execute itself.

artifact.path: relative POSIX path; no absolute path and no parent escape

rules: A package is data; installation is an explicit operator action.
Artifact paths are relative and stay inside the package root.
Every artifact carries a sha256 and a size.
Dependencies are closed: an index install plan refuses an unknown package or version.
Dependency ordering is deterministic and cycle detection fails closed.
A signature proves provenance; it grants no capability and executes nothing.
